title: The Borrowed Undertow
author: Ada Okonkwo
blurb: Dominic Dunmore, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
